items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Another one I didn't know, Soncio, Johnny Soncio. I didn't know him.

ctx.x: He just played a nice horn, that's all. That's funny about Hilaire because you never hear about him down here, but he worked with all the New Orleans guys up there. Yeah. Played with them up there.

Well, how he got with me, I don't know. He might have left four hours from here. I don't know. I didn't know anybody from here, but I knew he was from New Orleans. When I was from Chicago, everybody said, you know what? Another one I didn't know, Soncio, Johnny Soncio. I didn't know him.
He left kind of early too. Who were some of the good bass players down here? Huh? Who were some of the good bass players that played with writing bands?
